text.opengl: Create the bloom framebuffer and its mip chain: a `BloomMip` struct (float and integer size, texture) and a `BloomFBO` struct (framebuffer, vector of mips), `InitBloomFBO` creating six `GL_R11F_G11F_B10F` textures, each half the size of the one before (starting at half the window), with linear filtering and edge clamping, and attaching the first one to the framebuffer; `DestroyBloomFBO` for the cleanup. Call it for the window size with 6 levels.
text.vulkan: Create the bloom framebuffer and its mip chain: a `BloomMip` struct (float and integer size, image, memory, view, framebuffer) and a `BloomFBO` struct (the render pass that writes a level, the vector of mips), and `InitBloomFBO`, which creates the render pass and six `VK_FORMAT_B10G11R11_UFLOAT_PACK32` images, each half the size of the one before (starting at half the window), with their views and framebuffers; `DestroyBloomFBO` for the cleanup. Call it for the window size with 6 levels.
text.d3d12: Create the bloom's mip chain: the `BloomMip` struct (float and integer size, the texture, its RTV and SRV slots) and the `BloomFBO` struct (a vector of mips), and `InitBloomFBO`, which creates six `R11G11B10_FLOAT` render-target textures, each half the size of the one before (starting at half the window), with an RTV and an SRV each. Make room for the views in the heaps and call it for the window size with 6 levels.

hint.opengl: In the loop: `mipSize *= 0.5f; mipIntSize /= 2;`, `glTexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, GL_R11F_G11F_B10F, (int)mipSize.x, (int)mipSize.y, 0, GL_RGB, GL_FLOAT, nullptr);`, `bloomFBO.mipChain.push_back(mip);`. After it `glFramebufferTexture2D(…, GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, GL_TEXTURE_2D, bloomFBO.mipChain[0].texture, 0)`, `glDrawBuffers(1, attachments)` and the completeness check.
hint.vulkan: The render pass: one colour attachment, `loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_DONT_CARE`, `storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE`, `finalLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL`, a dependency from earlier fragment-shader reads / colour writes to this pass's colour writes and one from its colour writes to later fragment-shader reads. In the loop: `mipSize *= 0.5f; mipIntSize /= 2;`, `createImage(static_cast<uint32_t>(mipSize.x), static_cast<uint32_t>(mipSize.y), VK_FORMAT_B10G11R11_UFLOAT_PACK32, …, VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT, …)`, `createImageView`, `vkCreateFramebuffer`, `bloomFBO.mipChain.push_back(mip);`. Call it in `initVulkan()` right after `createHdrRenderPass()` (the bloom's pipelines will need its render pass).
hint.d3d12: In the loop: `mipSize.x *= 0.5f; … mipIntSize.x /= 2; …`, `CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(DXGI_FORMAT_R11G11B10_FLOAT, mipIntSize.x, mipIntSize.y, 1, 1, 1, 0, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_RENDER_TARGET)` in `PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE`, `mip.rtvIndex = FrameCount + 1 + i; mip.srvIndex = 4 + i;`, `CreateRenderTargetView` / `CreateShaderResourceView`, `bloomFBO.mipChain.push_back(mip);`. The RTV heap gets `FrameCount + 1 + 6` descriptors, the CBV/SRV heap `4 + 6`. `#include <vector>`.

text.opengl: Downsample the HDR scene through the mip chain every frame: write the 13-tap downsample shader and `RenderDownsamples` – for each level set the viewport to its size, attach its texture, draw the screen quad reading the previous level (the scene for the first), then read this level next. For now show the third level (100 × 75) in the window instead of the scene.
text.vulkan: Downsample the HDR scene through the mip chain every frame: write the 13-tap downsample shader and `RenderDownsamples` – for each level begin its render pass on its framebuffer, set the viewport and scissor to its size, draw the screen quad reading the previous level (the scene for the first), then read this level next. Give every level a descriptor set, and for now show the third level (100 × 75) in the window instead of the scene.
text.d3d12: Downsample the HDR scene through the mip chain every frame: write the 13-tap filter in `downsample.hlsl`, a pipeline state for it (one `R11G11B10_FLOAT` target, no depth buffer) and `RenderDownsamples` – for each level set the viewport and scissor rectangle to its size, make it the render target, draw the screen quad reading the previous level (the scene for the first), then read this level next. For now show the third level (100 × 75) in the window instead of the scene.

hint.opengl: In `downsample.fs` take the 13 samples a … m around `texCoord` (`x`, `y` = one source texel = `1.0 / srcResolution`) and add `e*0.125 + (a+c+g+i)*0.03125 + (b+d+f+h)*0.0625 + (j+k+l+m)*0.125`. In the loop: `glBindFramebuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, bloomFBO.FBO); RenderDownsamples(bloomFBO, downsampleShader, colorBuffer, glm::vec2((float)SCR_WIDTH, (float)SCR_HEIGHT));`, then back to framebuffer 0 and `glViewport(0, 0, SCR_WIDTH, SCR_HEIGHT)`. The final pass binds `bloomFBO.mipChain[2].texture`.
hint.vulkan: Push constants: `alignas(8) glm::vec2 srcResolution;` in `PushConstants` and the block up to `vec2 srcResolution` in `downsample.frag`. In `downsample.frag` take the 13 samples a … m around `texCoord` (`x`, `y` = one source texel = `1.0 / pc.srcResolution`) and add `e*0.125 + (a+c+g+i)*0.03125 + (b+d+f+h)*0.0625 + (j+k+l+m)*0.125`. `downsamplePipeline` with `bloomFBO.renderPass`; `for (BloomMip& mip : bloomFBO.mipChain) createDescriptorSet(mip.view, colorBufferSampler, mip.descriptorSet);` (the pool now has 9 sets). In `recordCommandBuffer()` after the HDR pass: `RenderDownsamples(bloomFBO, commandBuffer, downsamplePipeline, pipelineLayout, hdrDescriptorSet, glm::vec2((float)swapChainExtent.width, (float)swapChainExtent.height));`, then the window's viewport and scissor again; the final pass binds `bloomFBO.mipChain[2].descriptorSet`.
hint.d3d12: In `downsample.hlsl` take the 13 samples a … m around `texCoord` (`x`, `y` = one source texel = `1.0f / srcResolution`) and add `e*0.125 + (a+c+g+i)*0.03125 + (b+d+f+h)*0.0625 + (j+k+l+m)*0.125`. In `PopulateCommandList` after the scene: `RenderDownsamples(m_bloomFBO, 3, XMFLOAT2(static_cast<float>(m_width), static_cast<float>(m_height)));`, then `RSSetViewports(1, &m_viewport)` and `RSSetScissorRects(1, &m_scissorRect)` again. The final pass binds `m_bloomFBO.mipChain[2].srvIndex`.

text.opengl: Upsample back up the chain: write the tent-filter upsample shader and `RenderUpsamples` – from the smallest level up, read level i and draw it with additive blending (`GL_ONE, GL_ONE`) into level i − 1 (viewport and attachment of level i − 1). The filter radius is 0.005 in texture coordinates. For now show level 0 – the finished bloom texture – in the window.
text.vulkan: Upsample back up the chain: a second render pass for the levels that loads their contents (`loadOp LOAD`), the tent-filter upsample shader, a `blendEnable` parameter for `createPipeline` (additive blending ONE / ONE), and `RenderUpsamples` – from the smallest level up, read level i and draw it into level i − 1 (its framebuffer, viewport and scissor), adding to what the downsample left there. The filter radius is 0.005 in texture coordinates. For now show level 0 – the finished bloom texture – in the window.
text.d3d12: Upsample back up the chain: write the tent filter in `upsample.hlsl`, a pipeline state for it with additive blending (ONE, ONE), and `RenderUpsamples` – from the smallest level up, read level i and draw it into level i − 1 (its viewport and RTV). The filter radius is 0.005 in texture coordinates. For now show level 0 – the finished bloom texture – in the window.

hint.opengl: `for (int i = (int)bloomFBO.mipChain.size() - 1; i > 0; i--)` with `mip = mipChain[i]`, `nextMip = mipChain[i - 1]`; `glEnable(GL_BLEND); glBlendFunc(GL_ONE, GL_ONE); glBlendEquation(GL_FUNC_ADD);` before and `glDisable(GL_BLEND)` after the loop. `upsample.fs`: 9 samples `filterRadius` apart, `e*4 + (b+d+f+h)*2 + (a+c+g+i)`, divided by 16.
hint.vulkan: In `InitBloomFBO` change the attachment to `loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_LOAD`, `initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL` and create `bloomFBO.upsampleRenderPass` with the same create info (destroy it in `DestroyBloomFBO`). `createPipeline(…, VkBool32 blendEnable, …)`: `colorBlendAttachment.blendEnable = blendEnable;` with `srcColorBlendFactor = dstColorBlendFactor = VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE`, `colorBlendOp = VK_BLEND_OP_ADD` (the same for alpha); `VK_FALSE` for the existing pipelines, `VK_TRUE` for `upsamplePipeline` (`bloomFBO.upsampleRenderPass`). `float filterRadius;` in `PushConstants`, `float bloomFilterRadius = 0.005f;`. `for (int i = (int)bloomFBO.mipChain.size() - 1; i > 0; i--)` with `mip = mipChain[i]`, `nextMip = mipChain[i - 1]`. `upsample.frag`: 9 samples `pc.filterRadius` apart, `e*4 + (b+d+f+h)*2 + (a+c+g+i)`, divided by 16.
hint.d3d12: `for (int i = static_cast<int>(bloomFBO.mipChain.size()) - 1; i > 0; i--)` with `mip = mipChain[i]`, `nextMip = mipChain[i - 1]`. The pipeline state: `BlendState.RenderTarget[0]` with `SrcBlend = DestBlend = D3D12_BLEND_ONE`, `BlendOp = ADD`; reset `psoDesc.BlendState` afterwards for the final screen quad. `upsample.hlsl`: 9 samples `filterRadius` apart, `e*4 + (b+d+f+h)*2 + (a+c+g+i)`, divided by 16. A global `float bloomFilterRadius = 0.005f;`.

text.opengl: Mix the bloom texture into the scene in the final pass: the scene on unit 0, the bloom texture (level 0) on unit 1 (sampler `bloomBlur`), and in `bloom_final.fs` `mix(hdrColor, bloomColor, bloomStrength)` with a bloom strength of 0.04 before the tone mapping.
text.vulkan: Mix the bloom texture into the scene in the final pass: the scene at binding 1, the bloom texture (level 0) at binding 2 (sampler `bloomBlur`), and in `bloom_final.frag` `mix(hdrColor, bloomColor, ubo.bloomStrength)` with a bloom strength of 0.04 before the tone mapping.
text.d3d12: Mix the bloom texture into the scene in the final pass: the scene on root parameter 2 again, the bloom texture (level 0) on a new root parameter 3 (`Texture2D bloomBlur : register(t1)`), and in `bloom_final.hlsl` `lerp(hdrColor, bloomColor, bloomStrength)` with a bloom strength of 0.04 before the tone mapping.

hint.opengl: `float bloomStrength = 0.04f;`, `shaderBloomFinal.setInt("bloomBlur", 1);` once; in the final pass `glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, colorBuffer)` on unit 0, `glActiveTexture(GL_TEXTURE1); glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, bloomFBO.mipChain[0].texture);`, `setFloat("bloomStrength", bloomStrength)`. A linear interpolation instead of an addition keeps the energy: 96 % scene, 4 % bloom.
hint.vulkan: `float bloomStrength = 0.04f;`, `float bloomStrength;` after `exposure` in `UniformBufferObject` and in the shader's block, `ubo.bloomStrength = bloomStrength;` in `updateUniformBuffer()`. A third layout binding (binding 2, combined image sampler, fragment stage), the pool for 10 sets (10 uniform buffers, 20 image samplers), `createBloomDescriptorSet(hdrColorImageView, bloomFBO.mipChain[0].view, colorBufferSampler, bloomDescriptorSet)` (the `bloom` chapter's helper) and the final pass binds `bloomDescriptorSet`. A linear interpolation instead of an addition keeps the energy: 96 % scene, 4 % bloom.
hint.d3d12: The root signature gets a third descriptor range (`ranges[2].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV, 1, 1)`) and `rootParameters[3].InitAsDescriptorTable(1, &ranges[2], D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL)`. `float bloomStrength = 0.04f;` and `float bloomStrength;` in `HdrConstants` (C++ and HLSL). A linear interpolation instead of an addition keeps the energy: 96 % scene, 4 % bloom.

text.opengl: Against "fireflies" (single very bright pixels that flicker when they move): in the first downsample only, weight each of the five 4-sample groups by the Karis average `1 / (1 + luma / 4)` of its sRGB colour. A `mipLevel` uniform says which pass it is: 0 for the first, 1 after it.
text.vulkan: Against "fireflies" (single very bright pixels that flicker when they move): in the first downsample only, weight each of the five 4-sample groups by the Karis average `1 / (1 + luma / 4)` of its sRGB colour. A `mipLevel` push constant says which pass it is: 0 for the first, 1 after it.
text.d3d12: Against "fireflies": in the first downsample only, weight each of the five 4-sample groups by the Karis average `1 / (1 + luma / 4)` of its sRGB colour. A `mipLevel` root constant says which pass it is: 0 for the first, 1 after it.

hint.opengl: In `RenderDownsamples`: `downsampleShader.setInt("mipLevel", 0);` before the loop and `if (i == 0) { downsampleShader.setInt("mipLevel", 1); }` at the end of the first iteration. `downsample.fs`: learnopengl's `PowVec3`, `ToSRGB`, `sRGBToLuma` (0.299, 0.587, 0.114) and `KarisAverage`; for `mipLevel == 0` the groups `(a+b+d+e) * (0.125f/4.0f)` … `(j+k+l+m) * (0.5f/4.0f)`, each `*= KarisAverage(…)`, summed, `max(downsample, 0.0001f)`; otherwise the old weights.
hint.vulkan: `int mipLevel;` at the end of `PushConstants` and of the shader's block. In `RenderDownsamples`: `constants.mipLevel = 0;` before the loop and `if (i == 0) { constants.mipLevel = 1; }` at the end of the first iteration. `downsample.frag`: learnopengl's `PowVec3`, `ToSRGB`, `sRGBToLuma` (0.299, 0.587, 0.114) and `KarisAverage`; for `pc.mipLevel == 0` the groups `(a+b+d+e) * (0.125/4.0)` … `(j+k+l+m) * (0.5/4.0)`, each `*= KarisAverage(…)`, summed, `max(downsample, 0.0001)`; otherwise the old weights.
hint.d3d12: In `RenderDownsamples`: `downsampleConstants.mipLevel = 0;` before the loop and `if (i == 0) { downsampleConstants.mipLevel = 1; }` at the end of the first iteration. `downsample.hlsl`: `int mipLevel;` in the cbuffer, learnopengl's `PowVec3`, `ToSRGB`, `sRGBToLuma` (0.299, 0.587, 0.114) and `KarisAverage`; for `mipLevel == 0` the groups `(a + b + d + e) * (0.125f / 4.0f)` … `(j + k + l + m) * (0.5f / 4.0f)`, each `*= KarisAverage(…)`, summed, `max(downsample, 0.0001f)`; otherwise the old weights.
